description:
## Why

`LintResult::Warn`, `LintResult::Error`, and `LintResult::Fatal` carry `detail: &'static str`. This is cheap and allocation-free in the common path, but it has two operational consequences:

1. **Serde deserialization leaks.** When the `serde` feature is on, deserializing `Finding` / `EvaluationReport` requires `'de: 'static`. The `de_static_str` helper allocates a leaked Box<str> per unique detail string. In long-running services that deserialize findings from a database or message queue (e.g. a TLS policy daemon), process memory grows without bound.
2. **Dynamic detail messages are not possible.** Lints can only report static strings; runtime-formatted detail (e.g. 'serial `{}` exceeds CA/B Forum limit of 64 octets') has to be either skipped or encoded as a separate field with structured shape.

## What

Migrate `LintResult::Warn/Error/Fatal` detail field from `&'static str` to `Cow<'static, str>`. This:

- Lets lints return either a `&'static str` (zero-cost, same as today) OR a runtime-formatted `String`.
- Removes the `'de: 'static` serde bound and the leaked-allocation behavior.
- Is a **breaking change** for any consumer that pattern-matches `LintResult::Warn { detail: &str }` — they need to adapt to `Cow<str>`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `LintResult::Warn/Error/Fatal` detail field is `Cow<'static, str>`.
- [ ] Existing static-string lint constructors still compile (via `Cow::Borrowed`).
- [ ] One new lint added that uses `Cow::Owned` to demonstrate dynamic detail (e.g. report the actual non-conforming value).
- [ ] Serde deserialization no longer leaks: `de_static_str` removed; `'de: 'static` bound dropped.
- [ ] Crate version bumped (semver-breaking on pkix-lint).
- [ ] Migration note in CHANGELOG.

## Filed as

Tracker for pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:66, :132, :491 and report.rs:71+ comments asking for this work. Surfaced by PKIX-agp7.2 sweep audit.
title: pkix-lint: migrate LintResult detail from &'static str to Cow<'static, str>
